description: Watch a whole list instead of one reference at a time: up to 25 citations or package versions re-checked every day for 30 days under one token. US$5 a portfolio — 20 cents a reference, under a cent a check — and the first check on every reference is answered and signed immediately. Each real change carries its own signed receipt, and nothing is sent when nothing changed. ONE purchase covers the whole list: for a single subject on its own, use watch_add. Returns a read URL and a token shown once. Comes with an Ed25519-signed receipt covering the question, the verdict, the sources and the time, checkable offline against the published key at /.well-known/factstamp-issuer.json — so the check itself can be audited later by someone who was not here.

items.description: Up to 25 references. A repeated reference is charged once.

kind.description: What kind of reference this is.

subject.description: The DOI, arXiv ID or title; for a package, 'express@4.18.2' or 'npm:express@4.18.2'.

webhook.description: Optional https URL: each recorded change on any reference is POSTed there as JSON.
